What is our profit margin by genre?

tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT g.GenreId, g.Name AS Genre,
       ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity),2) AS revenue,
       SUM(il.Quantity) AS qty_sold,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(il.UnitPrice*il.Quantity) / (SELECT SUM(UnitPrice*Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine), 2) AS pct_of_total_revenue
FROM InvoiceLine il
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY revenue DESC;"}
